summary: Batch 7 UI QA 'Campaigns + My Tools' (4 target screens + 2 regression loads) at 1920x1080 as forest@imosapp.com. All 4 target screens (/campaigns/dashboard, /settings/date-triggers, /jessie, /team) pass: shared ScreenHeader renders with correct testids and titles, back chevrons present, gold theming applied, no em dashes in visible text, no iOS blue on any nav/pill/primary/tab. All requested interactive testids exist (see extras). Verified pending-send-card is gold (#C9A962) with black text and count=1 (NOT tapped). Verified enrollment row -> /contact/<id> navigation. Verified campaign-dashboard-settings gear -> /campaigns navigation. Verified date-triggers tabs switch and all 3 trigger cards + switches render (not toggled). Holidays tab shows template input, delivery pills, save button, and 15+ holiday rows. Jessi voice/text/send present; send button becomes enabled after typing. Team chat has empty state with No channels yet and gold Create Channel; new-channel panel opens and cancels cleanly. Batch 6 regression loads OK: /seo-health header + score card render, /reports/team-performance header renders. However /reports/team-performance now shows a REGRESSION: 176 count-text nodes rendered in iOS blue rgb(0,122,255) inside every rep-row and team-sales-store row (small '0' numbers - the count of sold cars or similar). Batch 6 previously flagged only 1 element - this is a much larger blue-text regression on the team-performance screen (Batch 6 scope) and should be fixed.

ui_bugs.issue: 176 small count-text nodes (the numeric '0' inside every rep-row-<id> and team-sales-store-<id>) render with color rgb(0,122,255) (iOS blue). This is a regression from iteration_301 which had only 1 blue element. Every rep row and store row now shows blue numeric labels. Not a Batch 7 target but requested to verify.

action_items: Fix iOS blue (rgb(0,122,255)) color on numeric count text inside rep-row-* and team-sales-store-* on /reports/team-performance. Likely a Text style using system link/blue color rather than theme accent. Should be white/gray or gold per Batch 6+ spec.
critical_code_review_comments: Batch 7 target screens are clean and fully match the ScreenHeader + gold accent standard. The only remaining leak of iOS blue found is on the Batch-6 team-performance screen, and it appears in a repeating row template so it multiplies quickly - worth catching in a lint or shared style rule (e.g. forbid raw #007AFF in RN Text styles).
Team Chat correctly hides from the tab bar and shows a real empty state; back chevron ('team-chat-header-back') uses canGoBack fallback (verified header present).
Jessi 'jessi-send-btn' correctly toggles disabled state on input change (verified true -> null).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on Batch 7 targets (4/4 screens pass all header/testid/theming checks). 1 regression bug found on Batch 6 /reports/team-performance.

rca of the issue: Team-performance blue-text regression: Every rep row and store subtotal renders a small numeric count with color rgb(0,122,255). Likely a Text style in the row/store subtotal component still uses the raw iOS default link color (#007AFF) instead of a themed color (theme.text or theme.accent). Grep candidates: /app/frontend/app/reports/team-performance.tsx or shared rep-row component - search for '007AFF', 'color: \'#007A', or default Text without color for the sold-count field. Fix by explicitly setting color to theme.text (white/gray) or theme.accent (#C9A962).
